en: In Spiritual Depression, Lloyd-Jones says:
Satan can't take away your salvation,
but he can steal your joy.
This kind of slump comes entirely
from not knowing God's Word.

text:
이런 침체에 빠진 자들이
하지 말아야 될 것이
en: And there's one thing people in it
must not do.
You'd never guess it,

text:
로이드 존스의 설교를
아직 읽지 못했다면
en: if you haven't read Lloyd-Jones yet.

text:
하지 말아야 될 게
뭔지 아십니까?
en: Do you know what it is?
"Don't pray."

text:
그런 영적 침체에 빠졌을 때
*기도하지 마라*
en: In a spiritual slump like that, don't pray.
That's what he says.

text:
이 침체에서 건져주시기를
기도하지 마라는 거예요
en: Don't pray to be pulled out of it.
Christians always pray,
and we should pray without ceasing,
but in this case, stop praying for a moment
and think. You have to think.
Your direction is off.
So feeling moved at a retreat
can make it worse.

text:
은혜를 받아서
삶의 방향이 바뀌진 않아요
en: Being moved doesn't change your direction.

text:
그러면 그 은혜가 떨어지면 또
은혜가 떨어지면 또 또
en: The feeling fades, and fades again, and again,
until you think, "Even the Spirit has no power,"
and bit by bit you end up living like the world.
Stop praying and think first.
Check first whether you rightly know
what you believe.
Your starting point was wrong.
